title: Running and verifying a multi-persona prompt pipeline
description: Walk through loading skill files, enforcing context isolation per step, running the four-step loop, and verifying the final prompt in Python.

steps.description: The module header summarizes the four architectural rules (persona before rules, explicit skill pasting, attacker isolation via `sees`, and per-step temperatures) and defines the word lists (`HEDGES`, `REFUSALS`, `ESCALATIONS`) used by the code verifier.

`strip_front_matter` removes the YAML header between `---` markers from a `SKILL.md` file. `load_skill` reads `<skills_dir>/<name>/SKILL.md` and raises `FileNotFoundError` if a skill is missing so the pipeline never runs silently without its rules.

`build_system` places the step's role before the pasted skill body. `build_user` enforces context isolation: it iterates over `step["sees"]` and includes only those named artifacts from `context` before appending `step["instruction"]`.
`run_step` calls `chat()` with each step's own temperature and the shared seed, while `run_pipeline` loops over `cfg["steps"]` in order and stores each reply under `context[step["writes"]]`.

`verify(prompt)` tests the finished prompt in Python against six concrete checks (role, scope, refusal, escalation, format, and hedge-free wording), and the `__main__` block runs the pipeline and prints the PASS/FAIL table.
